metadata.scenario: A caller requests clarification of office hours and location details for an upcoming visit. Category: General Information.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Thomas White. I’m calling because I need some information about your services. Of course, Thomas! What specific information are you looking for? I’m considering care for my mother, who has Alzheimer's. I need to clarify your office hours and location for an upcoming visit. Absolutely, I can help with that. Our office is located at 2847 North Ridge Road, Suite 205, Wichita, KS 67205. Thanks for that. And what are your office hours? We're open Monday to Friday from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and Sundays are on-call for emergencies only. Okay, great. So, if I wanted to come in, I could do that on a weekday? Yes, absolutely! Any weekday during our business hours would work. Perfect. I also heard you offer specialized dementia care. Can you tell me more about that? Certainly! We provide dementia and Alzheimer’s care at a rate of $32 to $40 per hour, focused on personalized support. That sounds promising. What about respite services for family caregivers? We offer respite care at a rate of $30 to $38 per hour, providing temporary relief for family caregivers. That could be really helpful for me. How would I go about setting that up? I can assist you with that! First, we would need to schedule an assessment to discuss your mother's specific needs. Sounds good. Can we schedule that? Sure! I can connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, who handles assessments and scheduling. Great! What’s her number? You can reach her directly at +13165559203, and she’s available Monday to Saturday. I'll give her a call. Thank you for your help today, Margaret! You’re welcome, Thomas! If you have any more questions, feel free to reach out anytime. Will do! Have a great day! You too, take care!
